name: foodrush-saas-platform
description: Multi-vendor Restaurant SaaS Platform – College Project

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../restaurant-service && npm install && cd ../menu-service && npm install && cd ../cart-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:restaurant" "npm run start:menu" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:cart" "npm run start:frontend" --names "GATEWAY,AUTH,RESTAURANT,MENU,ORDER,CART,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green,blue,magenta,red,white"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:restaurant" "npm run start:menu" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:cart" "npm run start:frontend" --names "GW,AUTH,REST,MENU,ORDER,CART,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,green,blue,magenta,red,white"
